Reader Mode engineering vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume a working reader view covers storefront language. Xcode, entitlements, and Connect actually separate in-app reading behavior from product-page copy:

  • Reader view in the app — how your binary strips ads, reflows article HTML, or presents a clean reading layout. Controls what buyers experience after install. Does not generate Chinese listing text.
  • Article parsing and content extraction — engineering work that turns a messy web page into readable text. Separate from the zh-Hans description paragraph that explains distraction-free reading to buyers.
  • Typography and theme inside reader mode — font choices, line spacing, and dark-background reader skins in the app. Listing copy describes benefits; in-app styling is engineering.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of reader-mode features in the binary.

A working Reader Mode experience and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other.

What China buyers see when zh-Hans Reader Mode copy is missing

Reading-app purchasers browsing the China App Store evaluate distraction-free claims in the first scroll. Common failure modes when only en-US is filled:

  • English title and subtitle — app name and tagline still Latin script while competitors show native Chinese reading positioning
  • Untranslated Reader Mode badges on screenshots — overlay lines like "Reader Mode", "Safari Reader", "Distraction-free reading", or "Clean article view" remain English on zh-Hans gallery frames
  • Reading value in English — description opens with US reader marketing ("Strip away clutter with Reader Mode") that China readers skim past or misread
  • Keyword field still en-US — buyers search 阅读器模式, 无干扰阅读, 专注阅读, or Safari 阅读器; an English-only keyword row misses China Search intent
  • Mixed page — Chinese description pasted once but screenshot captions and subtitle still English — reads unfinished next to localized competitors
  • Robotic machine translation — stiff 翻译腔 for reader features instead of the phrasing Chinese storefront readers expect (阅读器模式, 无干扰阅读, 纯净阅读)

Better zh-Hans listing copy helps reading-focused buyers understand reader-mode benefits before install. It does not replace reader-view engineering, content parsing, or Apple's review decisions.

Common mistakes on Reader Mode zh-Hans listings

  • Assuming reader view localizes automatically — reader mode shipped in the binary; zh-Hans row never added or left blank
  • Only translating the description — subtitle, keywords, and Reader Mode screenshot caption lines still English
  • Reusing US Reader Mode badges verbatim — Latin "Distraction-free reading" badges on zh-Hans screenshots signal unfinished localization
  • Conflating Reader Mode with Dark Mode — listing says 深色模式 when the hero feature is article view, not appearance themes
  • Over-claiming Safari Reader — zh-Hans copy implies the app is Safari instead of offering a Safari-style reader experience
  • Ignoring caption fields per localization — zh-Hans screenshot set uploaded but overlay text fields never saved; see Screenshot captions in Simplified Chinese
  • Expecting AppLocale to build reader parsing — content extraction, web-view configuration, and in-app reader UI are outside listing rewrite scope

Connect checklist before you order Reader Mode listing copy

FAQ

Does shipping Reader Mode auto-translate my China listing?

No. Reader views, article parsing, and distraction-free reading UX control in-app behavior — they do not create or fill a Simplified Chinese localization row. Empty or English zh-Hans fields mean China buyers see en-US fallback.

What listing fields does AppLocale rewrite for Reader Mode apps?

Paste-ready Simplified Chinese (zh-Hans) copy for App Store Connect listing fields you specify: title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text when included, and screenshot overlay or caption lines — rewritten from your English Reader Mode marketing originals.

How is this different from the Dark Mode or Background Audio pages?

Dark Mode copy markets light and dark appearance themes. Background Audio copy markets listen-while-reading playback. This page is Reader Mode as the product-page theme: distraction-free article views, Safari Reader-style layouts, and clean reading experiences.

Should zh-Hans copy mention Safari Reader by name?

When your English listing compares your reader to Safari Reader, we align zh-Hans phrasing with terms Chinese buyers recognize — 阅读器模式, Safari 阅读器风格, 无干扰阅读 — without over-claiming Apple trademarks or implying your app is Safari.

Why do screenshot captions still say "Reader Mode" in English on China?

Caption and overlay fields are managed per localization. If you filled en-US screenshot text but never saved zh-Hans caption lines — or uploaded the same English-overlay PNGs to the Chinese set — China buyers see Latin reader badges on the product page.

What do I send after AppLocale payment?

Your live App Store listing URL, current English Reader Mode marketing listing (title, subtitle, keywords, description, promo if used, all screenshot caption lines), screenshot frame counts, and target locale (zh-Hans). Reply from the email address on your Stripe receipt — we deliver to that Stripe email within 24 hours.

Will localized Reader Mode listing copy improve Search ranking in China?

We do not guarantee keyword position, chart rank, or install growth. Complete zh-Hans metadata helps reading-focused buyers who already found your page understand reader-mode value in their language.
